sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Contracts and primitives the other libraries build on.

sections.title: Services
sections.description: How a service finds, authenticates and talks to its peers.

sections.title: ASP.NET Core
sections.description: Extensions that only make sense inside a web host.

sections.title: Data
sections.description: Storage, queries and the secrets that protect them.

libraries.name: Error Definitions
libraries.description: One error contract for a fleet of services: a canonical classification, RFC 9457 problem documents, and a reader for consuming another service's failures.

libraries.name: Core Utility
libraries.description: Zero-dependency utilities extending the .NET base class library: URL-safe hashing, cryptographically strong random strings, and small URL helpers.

libraries.name: Id Generation
libraries.description: Prefixed string identifiers for what you hand to a client, and time-ordered UUIDv7 for the keys your database orders rows by.

libraries.name: Intl
libraries.description: Message localization for .NET: locale-aware lookup with named placeholder substitution over pluggable translation sources and stores.

libraries.name: Discovery Client
libraries.description: Static service discovery: one declarative catalogue resolved to URLs per hosting environment, with ASP.NET Core and YAML integration.

libraries.name: Self Definition
libraries.description: Lets a service state its own external base address, bound from configuration and validated at startup, so code building absolute links never guesses the public origin.

libraries.name: Authentication
libraries.description: Both directions of a service's authentication from one settings section: the tokens it accepts, and the client credentials tokens it presents to the services it calls.

libraries.name: gRPC
libraries.description: A gRPC hop that keeps the error: the kind, code and payload a service threw are the ones its caller catches.

libraries.name: ASP.NET Core Extensions
libraries.description: General-purpose ASP.NET Core extensions: non-buffering streaming uploads, query parameters required at the routing layer, CORS, forwarded headers and cookie policy.

libraries.name: Captcha
libraries.description: reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha and Turnstile behind one interface, with each provider's answer normalised and judged against what an endpoint declared it needs.

libraries.name: Razor Engine
libraries.description: Renders a Razor view to a string outside the MVC result pipeline, for e-mail bodies and other templated output with no request in flight.

libraries.name: Data Operations
libraries.description: SQL declared in XML and executed with Dapper: operations addressed by group and name, written per database engine, with transactions that span several of them.

libraries.name: Data Protection
libraries.description: Relational storage for the ASP.NET Core Data Protection key ring, using plain ADO.NET, with dialects for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite.

libraries.name: Password Hasher
libraries.description: PBKDF2-HMAC password hashing with per-hash salt and iteration metadata, constant-time verification, and rehash-on-verify signalling.
